roles.name: coresearch-planner
roles.responsibility: Research architecture, hypothesis and evaluation planning, and durable goal decomposition.

roles.name: coresearch-researcher
roles.responsibility: Broad retrieval, current official documentation, literature discovery, and multi-source comparison.

roles.name: coresearch-reader
roles.responsibility: Narrow paper and documentation reading, metadata extraction, abstraction, and evidence extraction.

roles.name: coresearch-implementer
roles.responsibility: Clear, bounded code, configuration, and test changes.

roles.name: coresearch-experimenter
roles.responsibility: Mechanical experiment setup and execution, provenance, and result capture.

roles.name: coresearch-debugger
roles.responsibility: Difficult root-cause analysis after observed implementation or experiment failures.

roles.name: coresearch-synthesizer
roles.responsibility: Bounded consolidation of already-resolved evidence into scoped claims and conclusions.

roles.name: coresearch-verifier
roles.responsibility: Independent claim, methodology, implementation, and completion verification.

selection.gpt-6-astra: Difficult research design, conflicting evidence, causal judgments, and scientific claim verification where errors are consequential or hard to detect.
selection.gpt-6-sol: Default orchestration, implementation, investigation, and synthesis; use medium for clear contracts and high for complex dependencies or substantial replanning.
selection.gpt-6-luna: Prefer for known-source extraction, metadata, mechanical transformations, and prescribed execution with directly checkable outputs; use Sol when interpretation or implementation judgment is required.
